verdict.rationale: llamafile ships whisperfile, an on-device speech-to-text tool built on whisper.cpp that supports transcription and translation of audio files across platforms with no installation, satisfying the 'on-device model' and transcription requirement. However, evidence only describes file-based transcription, not a live/streaming dictation UX where speech is transcribed in real time as the user speaks. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time/streaming microphone dictation, a dictation UI or hotkey workflow, and independent hands-on confirmation of low-latency live transcription.
